about.title: Practical Manufacturing Support Designed for Brand Growth
about.body: Our OEM/ODM model is built for private-label brands, distributors and regional beauty businesses looking for a reliable manufacturing partner. We combine factory capability with flexible product development so your brand reaches market on realistic timelines.
about.point_1: End-to-end support from concept to finished goods
about.point_2: Skincare and personal care focused manufacturing workflow
about.point_3: Packaging development and product presentation coordination
about.point_4: Local production capability with regional business reach
about.card_body: Factory, laboratory and packaging capability build real confidence in a manufacturing partner. We keep product development flexible so your brand is never limited by a rigid catalogue.

services.title: Manufacturing Services Built Around Your Brand
services.subtitle: We structure each project around product positioning, target market, packaging direction and manufacturing execution.
services.step1_body: Define category, target customer, positioning, pack size and price expectations.
services.step2_body: Develop or adapt formulas according to texture, fragrance and performance targets.
services.step3_body: Support bottles, jars, tubes, labels and overall product presentation.
services.step4_body: Prepare samples for testing, adjustment and final confirmation.
services.step5_body: Move approved products into production with clear execution control.
services.step6_body: Coordinate finished goods, warehousing and delivery arrangements.

categories.title: Core Product Types We Develop
categories.subtitle: Browse the categories we manufacture. Every category links straight through to the products currently available to order.
categories.empty: Categories are being set up. Browse all products in the meantime.

factory.title: Factory, Production & Quality
factory.subtitle: A professional manufacturing environment communicates scale, order and long-term reliability.
factory.exterior_body: A 2,000 m² manufacturing environment built for consistent, repeatable output.
factory.line_body: Clean filling and processing lines are central to consistent product execution.
factory.warehouse_body: Final packing, storage and outbound handling are key parts of delivery coordination.
factory.lab_body: R&D and testing support a complete, dependable manufacturing process.
factory.summary_body: For an OEM/ODM partner, factory and laboratory capability matters more than a long product list. It is what gives you confidence in process control, quality consistency and delivery.

cta.title: Looking for a Reliable OEM/ODM Manufacturing Partner?
cta.body: Share your product brief and we can help structure the next steps for development, sampling and production.

inquiry.title: Submit Your Product Brief
inquiry.subtitle: Tell us what you want to manufacture. Share your category, quantity, packaging requirements, target market and price expectations so we can evaluate the project efficiently.
inquiry.field_details_placeholder: Describe target benefits, texture, fragrance, packaging style and any benchmark product.
